title: 2000美元折叠手机：苹果前CEO却说等了好久，新掌门能靠它赢回市场吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I don't know how much you got to see of the presentation today, but when we talk about these big transitions, not only in terms of the leadership,
segments.zh: 我不知道你今天看了多少发布会内容，但当我们谈论这些重大转变时，不仅是领导层的更迭，

segments.en: but also in terms of the product lineup and how those products are marketed.
segments.zh: 还有产品线以及这些产品的营销方式。

segments.en: How do you sort of look at the start of this new era? Well, I'm excited and I think a lot of people are.
segments.zh: 你如何看待这个新时代的开端？我很兴奋，我想很多人也是。

segments.en: John Turner has an excellent reputation as someone who understands products and you know, products is more than building them
segments.zh: 约翰·特纳在理解产品方面声誉卓著，你知道，产品不仅仅是制造出来并通过渠道供应。

segments.en: and supplying them through the channels. Products are about focusing on what makes people really want a product
segments.zh: 产品关乎于聚焦那些真正让人们想要并欣赏它的特质。

segments.en: and really appreciate it. And then word of mouth becomes incredibly powerful in terms of acceptance of products.
segments.zh: 然后口碑在产品的接受度方面变得极其强大。

segments.en: And that's always been true with Apple. So I think it's a great time and I think the number of products that are coming out, I've never seen so many products come out at one time from Apple.
segments.zh: 对苹果来说一直如此。所以我认为这是一个伟大的时刻，而且我从未见过苹果一次性推出这么多产品。

segments.en: The foldable product is something I've wanted for a long time.
segments.zh: 可折叠产品是我期待已久的。

segments.en: I'm excited about it, but I'm excited about many of the things he's bringing to the market.
segments.zh: 我对此感到兴奋，但他带来的许多其他东西也让我兴奋。

segments.en: So it's a pretty cool time at Apple. You know, one of my colleagues said this morning that this is probably the first time in a while where Apple had to get on stage at CEO
segments.zh: 所以现在是苹果很酷的时刻。你知道，我的一位同事今天早上说，这可能是苹果一段时间以来第一次需要CEO上台。

segments.en: and actually explain why we need a certain product.
segments.zh: 并解释为何需要特定产品。

segments.en: And he's talking about basically the foldable phone, a phone that's going to cost $2,000 right out of the gate.
segments.zh: 他谈的主要是可折叠手机，起步价2000美元。

segments.en: I think about some of the product launches you overseeing such as the wildly successful Macintosh iterations and then of course some of the less successful ones like the Newton.
segments.zh: 回顾你监督的产品发布，有非常成功的Macintosh系列，也有不太成功的Newton。
